recap.text: Pustule is a level 30 hobgoblin explosives merchant in the Silk Road market with an open sore on her cheek bubbling ooze onto a pink unicorn T-shirt. Donut uses full charisma to buy twenty-five hob-lobbers for 1,000 gold. Pustule licks one of Carl's boom jugs and offers half of a 7,500 gold valuation. Carl buys ten hobgoblin smoke curtains from her.

Carl buys sets of hobgoblin pus from Pustule, a magical detonator on the Silk Road. Inside a submarine a city boss is about to swallow, Carl yanks a fuse from a hob-lobber, fits pus in its place, duct-tapes a potion to it, and seals it in the captain's minifridge.

beats.headline: Hobgobs and Boom Sticks
beats.text: For the record: Pustule, hobgoblin, level 30, proprietor of Hobgobs and Boom Sticks in the Silk Road market. Mordecai's introduction: a little odd, but harmless, and "you'll be seeing a lot of each other." About six feet tall, an open sore on her cheek bubbling black and green ooze onto a threadbare pink T-shirt with a unicorn in sunglasses, and a smell of rot and sickness. Crawler Donut's first assessment, whispered: "She's ugly. Like really ugly."
beats.gist: Pustule is a level 30 hobgoblin explosives merchant in the Silk Road market.

beats.headline: Tiff the muskrat
beats.text: Goblin smoke bombs are crap, in her professional opinion; a hobgoblin smoke curtain works much better, and she has none tonight. What she has is hob-lobbers, twenty-five for 500 gold. In passing she mentions watching her mother bite the head off a vorpal muskrat. She was friends with Tiff, the muskrat. Her mother died of it. Crawler Donut, charisma at full, talks her down from 1,500 gold to 1,000 for the lot.
beats.gist: Pustule sells hob-lobbers to Donut for 1,000 gold after Donut uses full charisma.

beats.headline: She licks the jug
beats.text: Crawler Carl sets one of his boom jugs on her table for a valuation. She rubs the side, makes a whimpering noise, and licks it. Then, all business: the material cost is much too high, and plain bottles of moonshine would be worth much more. She would sell it for about 7,500 gold and pay half that. "Beware of meteors!" she calls after them. From about fifty paces away, she also hears Crawler Donut's assessment of her. "Excellent hearing."

beats.headline: Ten smoke curtains, as promised
beats.text: She came through. Three more boxes of hob-lobbers, all impact-detonated, and a ten-pack of hobgoblin smoke curtains, round fused bombs meant to outperform the goblin kind. Crawler Carl buys all ten. That night, on a rooftop beside the magistrate's building, one of them fills the whole area like a heavy fog, far better than the goblin kind. Pustule had been correct.
beats.gist: Carl buys ten round fused hobgoblin smoke curtains and three boxes of impact-detonated hob-lobbers from Pustule.

beats.headline: On the way down
beats.text: On the stairs off the third floor, Crawler Carl runs through everyone they met there. Signet the half-naiad. Quint, the possum-faced pharmacist. Pustule, the hobgoblin explosives dealer. GumGum the orc. Miss Quill. Little Ricky Joe, the one-armed child dwarf. A week on that floor, and it felt like a millennium.
beats.gist: Carl runs through his acquaintances from the third floor, including Pustule, a hobgoblin explosives dealer.

beats.headline: Pus by the set
beats.text: Supplier note. On the Silk Road, Crawler Carl bought a few sets of hobgoblin pus from Pustule, the magical detonator, and he is burning through the expensive stuff. Inside a submarine a city boss is about to swallow, he yanks the fuse from a hob-lobber, fits a piece of pus in its place, duct-tapes a potion to it, and seals the lot in the captain's minifridge.
beats.gist: Carl buys hobgoblin pus from Pustule on the Silk Road and uses it in a submarine.
